Subject: 20% off Stormline Shells — offer ends Sunday
Preview: 420 g, 20k/20k rated. Built for sustained wet weather.
Body: If you've got a wet-weather trip coming up, this is a straightforward window to pick up the Stormline Shell at 20% off.

Here's what it is: a 420 g shell built from a 3-layer laminate with a 20,000 mm waterproof rating and 20,000 g/m² breathability. The 3-layer construction holds up through extended rain — not just a brief shower — and the breathability rating means you're not cooking on the climb up.

What it's not: it's a shell, not an insulating layer. Bring your mid if the temperature drops.

Offer ends Sunday. One click applies the discount at checkout.
